segments.name: Agricultural Sciences
segments.description: Develops, markets and sells crop protection chemicals and plant health products that help farmers protect crops and increase yields.
segments.evidence: We operate in a single distinct business segment.

revenueModel.text: FMC sells crop protection and plant health products to farmers through distributors, retailers, co-ops and directly to large growers in select countries.
revenueModel.evidence: We have our own sales and marketing organizations and access the market through a combination of distributors, retailers and co-ops in all four regions.

changes.text: In 2025, FMC approved a plan to divest its India commercial business, which is classified as held for sale and expected to close in 2026.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, the Board of Directors approved a plan to divest the Company's commercial business in India in response to ongoing commercial challenges in the country.
